The Wyoming Department of Environmental Quality -Water Quality Division (WDEQ-WQD) has completed the
review of the proposed Iron Horse Subdivision located in the Section 12, T14N, R67W,6P.M., in Laramie County,
Wyoming.The Iron Horse Subdivision will create 33 lots out of approximately 82.6 acres. The information was
submitted by Matthew Kaufman, Manager, and was signed by John Wetstein, PE, PG, a Wyoming Licensed Engineer
and Wyoming Professional Geologist.This letter represents the recommendations of the Wyoming Department of
Environmental Quality as required by W.S. 18-5-306(c).
The subdivision review consisted of (i) review of the proposed sewage system,(i) review of the proposed water
system, and (i)groundwater review of the proposed sewage system.The conclusion of WDEQ-WQD's subdivision
review results in either a“Non-Adverse”or“Adverse”recommendation.

Chapter 23 Rules
